components.name: LAME MP3 encoder
components.information: MP3出力にLAMEを使用しています。LAME本体は上記の配布元から、WebAssemblyへのビルド手順・接続コードはMediabunnyのソースから入手できます。アプリ側でLAME本体の変更は行っていません。ライブラリの変更・再ビルド・差し替えのためのソースは以下を参照してください。

# Third-party notices

celcodec's own code is covered by [LICENSE](LICENSE). Adapted code retains its
original copyright notices. The sources and runtime dependency listed below are
MIT-licensed; their copyright notices and the common MIT permission and warranty
text below must accompany copies or substantial portions of that software.

## Adapted code

celcodec contains adapted MIT-licensed CLIP format, material and regression
tests from these repositories, inspected at the following revisions:

- csp-paperback: `9256c0326dcbb628ed8c601bf17253c3ca2300dd`,
  https://github.com/stechdrive/csp-paperback.
  [Original MIT license](https://github.com/stechdrive/csp-paperback/blob/9256c0326dcbb628ed8c601bf17253c3ca2300dd/LICENSE).
  Copyright (c) 2025 stechdrive.
- xsheet-remap: `6fb67280fdebb2ecd93e0fd0e369b47b4f29a6e8`,
  https://github.com/stechdrive/xsheet-remap.
  [Original MIT license](https://github.com/stechdrive/xsheet-remap/blob/6fb67280fdebb2ecd93e0fd0e369b47b4f29a6e8/LICENSE).
  Copyright (c) 2026 stechdrive.

Later empty-vector and diagnostic changes from csp-paperback
`864c39c9d38ee1517f1cc533df260bbaac932342` retain the
[same MIT license and copyright](https://github.com/stechdrive/csp-paperback/blob/864c39c9d38ee1517f1cc533df260bbaac932342/LICENSE).

The extraction covers containers, BINC, native layer/timeline/audio editing,
raster tiles, text/gradients, brush resolution, vector strokes, effects and
Canvas helpers. Types, diagnostics,
environment boundaries and resource cleanup have been adapted. Per-file source
hashes, comparison results and test omissions are recorded in the source
repository's `docs/provenance.json` and `docs/extraction.md`.

xsheet-remap originally adapted these modules from csp-paperback
`2809271ba06b6ed03322abbc45f8a4e7a81c44ff`, with later effect/diagnostic updates at
`a4547482bcad1a65ca1515072bb7a14269c502f2`. That older port is a comparison source,
not assumed to be equivalent to the current csp-paperback repository.

## Adapted algorithms and format research

The original sources also use implementations and format research from these MIT
projects. This includes adapted algorithms, not only research references; for
example, `src/internal/vector.ts` retains curve-sampling and brush-stamping code
adapted from animeops/clip-tools through csp-paperback. These projects are not
installed runtime dependencies. Their notices are retained here alongside the
attributions in the source files.

- wamsoft/clipparse, `322a273c0e059d1dee9132af78289efa12a59522`:
  https://github.com/wamsoft/clipparse — Offscreen layout, raster tile permutation
  and reference color blend equations. Native alpha/opacity behavior in
  `src/render` was independently measured; see `docs/compositing.md`.
  Copyright (c) 2026 wamsoft.
  [Original MIT license](https://github.com/wamsoft/clipparse/blob/322a273c0e059d1dee9132af78289efa12a59522/LICENSE).
- animeops/clip-tools, `8807134932a39a009c980fb29acd1ae934354a7c`:
  https://github.com/animeops/clip-tools — adapted vector curve sampling and brush
  stamping; BINC, CLIP structure, brush dynamics and text-layout research.
  Copyright (c) 2026 AnimeOps.
  [Original MIT license](https://github.com/animeops/clip-tools/blob/8807134932a39a009c980fb29acd1ae934354a7c/LICENSE).
- Aodaruma/clipfile-rs, `bd88467fa80e63ad48c6c713fbfb5a8a116d798a` and
  `b3c4aefe3ba944f47f27aaf0777cbffc1038e75c` (`clipfile-svg-v0.2.0`):
  https://github.com/Aodaruma/clipfile-rs — CLIP container, database, timeline and
  vector layouts, including the modern 92-byte header.
  Copyright (c) 2026 Aodaruma.
  [Original MIT license](https://github.com/Aodaruma/clipfile-rs/blob/bd88467fa80e63ad48c6c713fbfb5a8a116d798a/LICENSE)
  and [the SVG release license](https://github.com/Aodaruma/clipfile-rs/blob/b3c4aefe3ba944f47f27aaf0777cbffc1038e75c/LICENSE).
- dobrokot/clip_to_psd, `e8db68c768f52ec91ba7530820f52537261cbad0`:
  https://github.com/dobrokot/clip_to_psd — text attributes, fill and image-effect
  layout research. The upstream MIT notice reads "Copyright (c) 2024" without
  an additional author name.
  [Original MIT license](https://github.com/dobrokot/clip_to_psd/blob/e8db68c768f52ec91ba7530820f52537261cbad0/LICENSE).
- al3ks1s/clip-tools, `e1d3d7ed4701ac84e9220127daa73c2cf90dd803`:
  https://github.com/al3ks1s/clip-tools — CLIP container and SQLite extraction
  research referenced by xsheet-remap. The upstream MIT notice reads
  "Copyright (c) 2024" without an additional author name.
  [Original MIT license](https://github.com/al3ks1s/clip-tools/blob/e1d3d7ed4701ac84e9220127daa73c2cf90dd803/LICENCE).
